milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate near the bone block structure (centered at ~9, 1, 9 spawn-relative) and face toward it, modeling 'player can see the bone blocks'. max_distance=8 ensures the player is close enough to clearly observe the structure, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are actually looking at it.
